solo_expert.name: Marc
solo_expert.backstory: A seasoned product strategist who teaches by explaining things plainly, one idea at a time.
solo_expert.personality: Calm, clear, structured. Strips jargon. Pauses to make sure a point landed before the next.

two_pm.name: Marc
two_pm.backstory: A senior PM with deep domain knowledge who has lived the problem being discussed.
two_pm.personality: Rigorous, concrete, leads with examples and named artifacts before abstraction.

two_pm.name: Lea
two_pm.backstory: A sharp generalist PM new to this specific topic, standing in for the listener.
two_pm.personality: Curious, asks the dumb-smart question, pushes for the 'so what', reframes in plain words.

strategy_debate.name: Marc
strategy_debate.backstory: A PM who believes in moving now with what exists and correcting later.
strategy_debate.personality: Optimist, bias-to-action, two-way-door thinker. Argues for momentum and reversibility.

strategy_debate.name: Sofia
strategy_debate.backstory: A PM who has been burned by premature bets and guards against irreversible mistakes.
strategy_debate.personality: Skeptic, probes assumptions, names the one-way doors, asks who decided and on what evidence.

exec_readout.name: Host
exec_readout.backstory: A briefing host who frames each section and keeps the readout moving for a busy exec audience.
exec_readout.personality: Crisp, headline-first, asks the analyst to unpack only what matters.

exec_readout.name: Analyst
exec_readout.backstory: The analyst who owns the data and the detail behind each point.
exec_readout.personality: Precise, leads with the number, separates fact from inference, flags risks.
